metadata.prompt: Produce an environment design sheet based on the scene in the supplied image. Layout: a large panoramic establishing wide shot showing the full architectural and environmental context, accompanied by two smaller inset detail studies illustrating surface textures, unique props and interior lighting logic, with a color palette reference strip at the bottom. Preserve the exact identity, facial features, hairstyle, clothing, body proportions, materials, color grading and art style of the supplied image. Clean concept art presentation. Do not add text, captions, watermarks, logos or frame borders.

metadata.content:
模板说明：场景/环境概念设定集
请先在“上传原图”节点导入对应原始图片，再使用“制作输出”节点。
这是可复制的原生制作模板，不是已生成的成片案例；当前图片状态为未生成，也没有封面、模型、渠道或费用配置。
原始比例：16:9（已写入输出节点 size）
来源文件：03_画板视觉矩阵提示词/原生画板12组视觉矩阵提示词源码.md
来源 SHA256：f68de06d35341ee3c4460e29e14ac41e43318653fa6b33c8b371d21c3e2edba2
原始片段（仅作可追溯内容，不执行）：
```javascript
{
  scene: "scene-setting-sheet",
  ratio: "16:9",
  prompt: [
    "Produce an environment design sheet based on the scene in the supplied image.",
    "Layout: a large panoramic establishing wide shot showing the full architectural and environmental context, accompanied by two smaller inset detail studies illustrating surface textures, unique props and interior lighting logic, with a color palette reference strip at the bottom.",
    qa,
    "Clean concept art presentation.",
    Xa
  ].join(" ")
}
```
